look_here_first: This one should jump out from ground level: a flat, essentially stemless rosette produces a large yellow four-petaled flower on an extraordinarily long, sharply 4-angled floral tube.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: acaulous/essentially stemless and usually under 10 cm tall

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: only basal irregularly pinnately lobed leaves

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: large radial yellow flower about 50–55 mm across

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: very long square 4-angled floral tube up to about 97 mm

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: 4 stamens in the Williamson County treatment
